target.queryText:
SELECT MIN(t.executed_ts) AS time,
       i.symbol || ' ' || t.side || ' ' || SUM(t.quantity) || ' @ '
         || printf('%.2f', SUM(t.quantity * t.price) / SUM(t.quantity))
         || CASE WHEN n.sentiment IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' || n.sentiment END
         || CASE WHEN n.note IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ': ' || n.note END AS text,
       t.side || COALESCE(',' || n.sentiment, '') AS tags
FROM trade_note n
JOIN trade t ON t.id = n.trade_id
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.side = 'BUY'
  AND i.symbol = '$symbol'
GROUP BY i.symbol, t.session_date, t.side, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts), n.sentiment, n.note
ORDER BY MIN(t.executed_ts)
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Market direction (M)
panels.description:
The "M" of CAN SLIM, read from the market proxy (NIFTYBEES by default) at the last scan.

- **Confirmed uptrend** — above a rising 50-day average with few distribution days. Buy signals are actionable.
- **Uptrend under pressure** — 4-5 distribution days, or below the 50-day. Be selective.
- **Correction** — below a falling 50-day average, or 6+ distribution days. Buy setups are held back.

A **distribution day** is an index decline of 0.2% or more on higher volume than the day before: institutions selling.

panels.title: Buy signals, and setups about to rally
panels.description:
Stocks that passed the screener.in fundamentals query and whose chart lines up with O'Neil's buy rules.

- **Buy: breakout today / in buy range** — closed above the base's pivot on at least 1.4x average volume, and is no more than 5% above it.
- **Watch: near pivot** — within 5% under the pivot of a sound base. This is the *about to rally* list: the breakout is a close above the pivot on heavy volume.
- **Extended** — broke out but is now past the 5% buy range; chasing it raises the risk.
- **Setup, market in correction** — would be a buy or a watch, but M is negative.

**CAN SLIM** shows each letter that passed; '-' failed, '?' unknown. **RS** is the 1-99 relative-strength percentile against everything priced in the scan; CAN SLIM wants 80+.

Click a symbol to chart it below. These are rule readings, not advice.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT symbol                         AS "Symbol",
       signal                         AS "Signal",
       letters                        AS "CAN SLIM",
       rs_rating                      AS "RS",
       close                          AS "Close",
       pivot                          AS "Pivot",
       ROUND(pct_from_pivot, 1)       AS "vs pivot %",
       base_sessions                  AS "Base (sessions)",
       ROUND(base_depth_pct, 1)       AS "Base depth %",
       ROUND(volume_ratio, 2)         AS "Volume vs 50d",
       ROUND(qtr_profit_growth, 1)    AS "Qtr profit %",
       ROUND(profit_growth_3y, 1)     AS "3y profit %",
       ROUND(roe, 1)                  AS "ROE %",
       reason                         AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_latest
WHERE signal IN ('BUY_BREAKOUT', 'BUY_ZONE', 'WATCH_SETUP', 'AVOID_MARKET', 'EXTENDED')
ORDER BY CASE signal WHEN 'BUY_BREAKOUT' THEN 0 WHEN 'BUY_ZONE' THEN 1 WHEN 'WATCH_SETUP' THEN 2
                     WHEN 'AVOID_MARKET' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
         letters_passed DESC, rs_rating DESC

panels.title: Rallies that have ended - sell signals
panels.description:
O'Neil's exits, checked for every stock with a rally to end: recent breakouts, open positions, and the configured universe.

- **Stop loss** — the close is 8% or more below the buy point (your average cost for a holding, otherwise the breakout's pivot).
- **Rally ended** — a close below the 50-day moving average on heavy volume (1.4x average or more).
- **Climax top** — 20%+ above the buy point and either up 25% in three weeks, or posting its biggest gain since the breakout on its heaviest volume: the run is exhausting itself.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT session_date, open, high, low, close, volume,
         LAG(close) OVER (ORDER BY session_date) AS previous_close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY session_date) AS n,
         MIN(session_date) OVER () AS first_day,
         MIN(date(session_date, '-3 months'), date(session_date, 'start of month', '-2 months', '-1 day')) AS quarter_from,
         MIN(date(session_date, '-12 months'), date(session_date, 'start of month', '-11 months', '-1 day')) AS year_from,
         MAX(volume) OVER (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 30 FOLLOWING) AS nearby_max,
         SUM(volume) OVER (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS volume50,
         COUNT(volume) OVER (ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sessions50
  FROM daily_bar
  WHERE instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE symbol = '$symbol')
),
standing AS (
  SELECT d.n,
         SUM(o.n > d.n - 20 AND o.volume IS NOT NULL) AS last20,
         SUM(o.n > d.n - 20 AND o.volume > d.volume) AS heavier20,
         SUM(o.n > d.n - 20 AND o.volume < d.volume) AS lighter20,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.quarter_from AND o.volume > d.volume) AS heavier_quarter,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.quarter_from AND o.volume < d.volume) AS lighter_quarter,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.year_from AND o.volume > d.volume) AS heavier_year,
         SUM(o.session_date > d.year_from AND o.volume < d.volume) AS lighter_year
  FROM sessions d
  JOIN sessions o ON o.n <= d.n AND (o.n > d.n - 20 OR o.session_date > d.year_from)
  GROUP BY d.n
),
day_facts AS (
  SELECT s.*, t.last20, t.heavier20, t.lighter20,
         CASE
           WHEN s.volume IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.year_from AND t.heavier_year = 0 THEN 'year high'
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.year_from AND t.lighter_year = 0 THEN 'year low'
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.quarter_from AND t.heavier_quarter = 0 THEN 'quarter high'
           WHEN s.first_day <= s.quarter_from AND t.lighter_quarter = 0 THEN 'quarter low'
         END AS extreme,
         s.close > s.previous_close
           AND ROUND(100.0 * (s.high - s.low) / s.previous_close, 6) >= 5
           AND ROUND(3 * (s.close - s.low) - 2 * (s.high - s.low), 6) >= 0
           AND s.sessions50 = 50 AND 50 * s.volume >= 3 * s.volume50 AS bull_snort
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN standing t ON t.n = s.n
),
volume_kind AS (
  SELECT session_date, extreme,
         CASE
           WHEN volume IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN bull_snort THEN 'bull snort'
           WHEN extreme IS NOT NULL THEN extreme
           WHEN last20 = 20 AND heavier20 <= 1 THEN 'heavy'
           WHEN last20 = 20 AND lighter20 <= 1 THEN 'light'
           WHEN close < COALESCE(previous_close, open) THEN 'down'
           ELSE 'up'
         END AS kind,
         volume + 0.15 * nearby_max AS marker_at,
         CASE WHEN volume > 1000000 AND ROUND(100.0 * (close - previous_close) / previous_close, 6) >= 4.95
              THEN volume + 0.07 * nearby_max END AS glow_at
  FROM day_facts
)
SELECT b.ts_epoch     AS time,
       b.open, b.high, b.low, b.close, b.volume,
       b.sma50        AS "SMA 50",
       b.sma200       AS "SMA 200",
       l.pivot        AS "Pivot",
       CASE WHEN h.signal IN ('BUY_BREAKOUT', 'BUY_ZONE') THEN b.close END AS "Buy signal",
       CASE WHEN h.signal LIKE 'SELL_%' THEN b.close END              AS "Sell signal",
       k.glow_at AS "Over 1 million shares, up 4.95% or more",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'down' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume, price down",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'up' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume, price up",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'heavy' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume ≥ 90th percentile of 20 sessions",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'light' THEN b.volume END AS "Volume ≤ 10th percentile of 20 sessions",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'bull snort' THEN b.volume END AS "Bull snort (range ≥ 5%, top-third close, up, 3× volume)",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'quarter high' THEN b.volume END AS "Highest volume in 3 months",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'quarter low' THEN b.volume END AS "Lowest volume in 3 months",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'year high' THEN b.volume END AS "Highest volume in 12 months",
       CASE WHEN k.kind = 'year low' THEN b.volume END AS "Lowest volume in 12 months",
       CASE WHEN k.extreme IN ('quarter high', 'quarter low') THEN k.marker_at END AS "Q · highest or lowest in 3 months",
       CASE WHEN k.extreme IN ('year high', 'year low') THEN k.marker_at END AS "Y · highest or lowest in 12 months"
FROM v_daily_bars b
LEFT JOIN volume_kind k ON k.session_date = b.session_date
LEFT JOIN v_canslim_latest l ON l.symbol = b.symbol
LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol, as_of, MAX(signal) AS signal FROM v_canslim_signal_history
           WHERE signal IN ('BUY_BREAKOUT', 'BUY_ZONE') OR signal LIKE 'SELL_%'
           GROUP BY symbol, as_of) h
       ON h.symbol = b.symbol AND h.as_of = b.session_date
WHERE b.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY b.session_date

panels.title: Every stock in the last scan, strongest relative strength first
panels.description:
The full score sheet, ordered by RS rating (1-99, a percentile of the weighted 12-month return against everything ranked in the scan). With the whole-market scan on, that is every liquid NSE and BSE equity above ₹1,000 Cr, and **Why scanned** reads *market* for the ones nobody asked about by name.

- **C** — latest quarter's profit up 25%+ year on year, with sales up 20%+.
- **A** — three-year profit growth 25%+ and ROE 17%+.
- **N** — within 15% of its 52-week high.
- **S** — more volume on up days than down days over 50 sessions.
- **L** — RS rating 80+.
- **I** — institutions (FII + DII) added to their holding last quarter.
- **M** — the market is in a confirmed uptrend.

C, A and I come from screener.in, so they are unknown ('?') for stocks that were scanned only because you hold them or they are in the configured universe.
- *Market* rows are only companies confirmed above ₹1,000 Cr of market cap, from their screener.in page, so their **C**, **A** and **I** are filled in. A listing whose page has not been read yet is not shown; the list grows over the first nights of the whole-market scan.

       LOWER(source)                  AS "Why scanned",
       signal                         AS "Signal",
       letters                        AS "CAN SLIM",
       letters_passed                 AS "Letters passed",
       rs_rating                      AS "RS",
       close                          AS "Close",
       ROUND(pct_from_high, 1)        AS "Below 52w high %",
       ROUND(up_down_volume, 2)       AS "Up/down volume",
       ROUND(qtr_profit_growth, 1)    AS "Qtr profit %",
       ROUND(qtr_sales_growth, 1)     AS "Qtr sales %",
       ROUND(profit_growth_3y, 1)     AS "3y profit %",
       ROUND(roe, 1)                  AS "ROE %",
       ROUND(institutional_change, 2) AS "FII+DII change",
       reason                         AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_latest
ORDER BY rs_rating IS NULL, rs_rating DESC, letters_passed DESC, symbol
targets.queryText:
SELECT symbol                         AS "Symbol",
       LOWER(source)                  AS "Why scanned",
       signal                         AS "Signal",
       letters                        AS "CAN SLIM",
       letters_passed                 AS "Letters passed",
       rs_rating                      AS "RS",
       close                          AS "Close",
       ROUND(pct_from_high, 1)        AS "Below 52w high %",
       ROUND(up_down_volume, 2)       AS "Up/down volume",
       ROUND(qtr_profit_growth, 1)    AS "Qtr profit %",
       ROUND(qtr_sales_growth, 1)     AS "Qtr sales %",
       ROUND(profit_growth_3y, 1)     AS "3y profit %",
       ROUND(roe, 1)                  AS "ROE %",
       ROUND(institutional_change, 2) AS "FII+DII change",
       reason                         AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_latest
ORDER BY rs_rating IS NULL, rs_rating DESC, letters_passed DESC, symbol
